articles.title: Police to increase patrols downtown amid safety concerns, neighborhood group says
articles.description:
A number of high-profile violent incidents in July has sparked renewed efforts to decrease crime.

The post Police to increase patrols downtown amid safety concerns, neighborhood group says appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Police will increase downtown patrols due to rising safety concerns.
High-profile violent incidents in July prompted this decision.
Residents can expect enhanced security measures in response to crime.

articles.title: A man accused of orchestrating Tupac Shakur’s 1996 killing is on trial. Here’s what to know.
articles.description:
Family members of the famed rapper were among supporters who gathered outside a Las Vegas courthouse Monday morning for the beginning of jury selection, which could continue through much of this week.

The post A man accused of orchestrating Tupac Shakur’s 1996 killing is on trial. Here’s what to know. appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Jury selection for Tupac Shakur's murder trial began on August 10, 2026, in Las Vegas.
Family members of Tupac Shakur attended the trial, showing ongoing community support.
The trial's outcome may influence discussions on unsolved crimes in Boston and nationwide.
